headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Boston Red Sox designated hitter Masataka Yoshida has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Additionally, Justin Slaten has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team for cash. The San Francisco Giants transferred third baseman Matt Chapman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.
